pages.title: Wait for Onset
pages.text: Hold use until the item finishes, then allow the effect to build. If a drink will not start, check the amount for one full serving. For flight you need both the active effect and saturation.

pages.title: Client or Pack?
pages.text: Check Psychedelicraft’s local visuals and sound controls if the gameplay benefit works but perception looks muted. On a server, a pack can change recipes, trades and balancing. Test familiar defaults in a separate world.
